accents.$description: The accent axis, dark resolution. Six user-selectable accents drawn straight from the Tailwind v4 palette: --accent is a FILL and must carry --on-accent at >=4.5, and it is also the focus ring, so it must clear 3:1 on --bg, --card AND --elevated. --accent-2 is TEXT and must clear 4.5 on --bg. Those three constraints are why the fills are not one ramp step: five accents sit at -500 and rose at -600. Teal, green, amber and blue take dark ink because at -500 they are too light to carry white; rose darkens to -600 instead, which the ring floor still permits at 3.12. Indigo is the default. On the desktop these become :root[data-accent="…"] blocks and feed shadcn's `primary` / `ring` / `sidebar-primary` slots, so choosing an accent re-tints every stock component with no per-component override.

accent-2.$description: The text-safe accent step. --accent is a fill (indigo-500 measures 4.37 as text on --bg and misses AA); this is what accent-coloured TEXT uses.

blue.$description: Fill blue-500, text blue-400. blue-600 with white ink measured 5.26 as a fill and 3.78 as a focus ring on --bg, and was the value here until the ring was measured on --elevated as well: shadcn's TabsList and ToggleGroup are `bg-muted` with 3px of padding that a 3px focus ring fills exactly, and blue-600 lands there at 2.83 against a 3:1 floor. blue-500 measures 4.01 there, and takes dark ink for the same reason teal, green and amber do.

on-accent.$description: Dark ink: blue-500 measures 3.71 with white.
Dark ink: the teal fill is too light to carry white text at AA.
Dark ink: the green fill is too light to carry white text at AA.
Dark ink: the amber fill is too light to carry white text at AA.

rose.$description: Fill rose-600, text rose-400. rose-500 measures 3.73 with white ink; rose-600 measures 4.78, ring 4.16.

accent.$description: The active accent. Defaults to indigo; the [data-accent] blocks override it.

accent-2.$description: The text-safe accent step: lighter than --accent in dark, darker in light. --accent is a fill and is not guaranteed to clear 4.5 as text.
